newsitem.title: CANADA: Brookfield Properties in takeover bid.
newsitem.headline: Brookfield Properties in takeover bid.

text.p: Brookfield Properties Corp said on Monday it offered to merge with Brookfield Homes Ltd in a deal in which Brookfield Homes shareholders would receive one common share of Brookfield Properties Corp for each 1.5 common shares of Brookfield Homes.
Brookfield Properties said public shareholders owned four percent of the shares outstanding in Brookfield Homes.
An institutional investor that owned 355,400 common shares of Brookfield Homes, representing 30 percent of the public float, agreed to vote for the amalgamation, Brookfield Properties said.
Brookfield Properties said the deal was subject to approval by a committee of independent shareholders of the board and Brookfield Homes shareholders.
If successful, Brookfield Properties said it would issue 788,912 common shares of Brookfield Properties.
It said the merger would enable Brookfield to consolidate its land development and home-building operations under Brookfield Properties and to simplify Brookfield's corporate structure.
